description: Search across DNS records by pattern and return matching domains plus the record values. Multiple search terms combine with AND — use separate calls for OR. Wildcards (`*`) are required for partial matches; otherwise the search is exact. Use this when sweeping the zone for SPF strings, TXT verification tokens, or arbitrary RDATA patterns. Do NOT use this when you already know the domain (use `dns_lookup`) or when the input is an IP (use `reverse_ip`).

include_additional_checks.description: If true, performs wildcard and domain activeness checks. Extra cost.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Recommended to start with 10 and increase if needed. Max: 1000.

preview.description: If true, returns just the domain names without additional information.

terms.description: Search terms array defining what to search for in DNS records (combined with AND logic). Must use wildcards for partial matches otherwise the search will be exact.

exclude.description: If true, excludes matching records from results.

name: reverse_dns
